basic_info.description: Dramatic 10-foot archways connect open yet intimate living areas for great circulation and flow. Soundly crafted two-unit condo with an elevator from two-car independent garage directly into your unit. The abundance of concrete and steel will cradle you in tranquility and calm.  Whether hosting a stylish dinner party or seeking a quiet retreat, this thoughtfully designed two-level residence transcends with ultimate privacy and fantastic location. Cozy up to a fire in your grand living space or host friends for a game in your oversized media den. Open chef's kitchen with gas range offers both a breakfast area and separate dining area with walk-out mature landscaped deck. Head downstairs to an en-suite primary, second bedroom, third sleeping alcove, guest bath, laundry room, and storage under the stairs. In-unit storage heaven with additional locked storage room in the impeccable garage. Nestled into the verdant hillside, this well-chosen site is blocks from iconic Dolores Park and vibrant 18th street.
